captions.detailed: An air-sprung dropper seatpost featuring a matte black finish with a red accent band. The lower outer sleeve is a smooth cylinder with measurement markings on the back and a brass-colored Schrader valve boss on the front. The inner post telescopes vertically via a prismatic joint, culminating in a two-bolt collar saddle clamp with metallic hardware at the top.
captions.instruction: Create a 3D model of an air-sprung dropper seatpost with a matte black lower outer sleeve, a telescoping inner post connected via a prismatic joint, a small brass-colored Schrader valve boss on the lower sleeve, and a two-bolt saddle clamp assembly at the top.
captions.factory: Construct the outer sleeve using a main cylinder, adding a smaller cylinder for the collar and a side cylinder for the valve boss. Model the inner telescoping post as a cylinder with a thin colored accent ring. Build the upper saddle clamp assembly using a combination of box primitives for the clamping plates and small cylinders for the mounting bolts, then define a prismatic joint between the outer sleeve and the inner post.
